#!/bin/bash

# Font Installation Script
# This script installs various fonts for use in the workspace

set -e

echo "Installing fonts..."

# Create fonts directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p ~/.local/share/fonts

# Install Google Fonts - Roboto family
echo "Installing Roboto fonts..."
cp /workspace/fonts/roboto/*.ttf ~/.local/share/fonts/ 2>/dev/null || echo "Roboto fonts not found, skipping..."

# Install Google Fonts - Open Sans family
echo "Installing Open Sans fonts..."
cp /workspace/fonts/open-sans/*.ttf ~/.local/share/fonts/ 2>/dev/null || echo "Open Sans fonts not found, skipping..."

# Install Nerd Fonts - FiraCode
echo "Installing FiraCode Nerd Font..."
cp /workspace/fonts/firacode/*.ttf ~/.local/share/fonts/ 2>/dev/null || echo "FiraCode fonts not found, skipping..."

# Install Nerd Fonts - Hack
echo "Installing Hack Nerd Font..."
cp /workspace/fonts/hack/*.ttf ~/.local/share/fonts/ 2>/dev/null || echo "Hack fonts not found, skipping..."

# Install custom/proprietary fonts
echo "Installing custom fonts..."
cp /workspace/fonts/custom/*.ttf ~/.local/share/fonts/ 2>/dev/null || echo "Custom fonts not found, skipping..."
cp /workspace/fonts/custom/*.otf ~/.local/share/fonts/ 2>/dev/null || echo "Custom OTF fonts not found, skipping..."

# Update font cache
echo "Updating font cache..."
fc-cache -fv ~/.local/share/fonts

echo "Font installation complete!"
echo ""
echo "Installed font families:"
echo "  - Roboto (Regular, Bold, Italic, Bold Italic, Light, Medium, Thin, Black)"
echo "  - Open Sans (Regular, Bold, Italic, Bold Italic, Light, SemiBold)"
echo "  - FiraCode Nerd Font (Regular, Bold, Light, Medium, Retina, SemiBold)"
echo "  - Hack Nerd Font (Regular, Bold, Italic, Bold Italic)"
echo "  - Custom workspace fonts"
</tool_response>
